predecessor_frontend.note: Historical A8 frontend remains immutable evidence; this artifact supersedes it only for future staging.

observations: One dedicated Firefox worker window only; no duplicate about:blank/second-window regression.
Ctrl+Space foregrounded the existing ChatGPT worker without manual window selection.
Manual Ctrl+V then Enter submitted the packet and the worker Firefox minimized.
A subsequent Ctrl+Space while the smoke projected SentUnconfirmed=1 reported pending durable acknowledgment and did not reopen/refocus Firefox.

behavior_contract.ready_transition: New READY work may notify but must not steal focus; Ctrl+Space is the explicit service gesture.
behavior_contract.service: Ctrl+Space activates the exact managed/captured Firefox worker and clipboard preparation remains explicit/manual-paste only.
behavior_contract.submit: Manual Enter is observed only in the prepared trusted worker; UI minimize follows after key delivery and does not imply durable success.
behavior_contract.pending_ack: While SentUnconfirmed>0, another Ctrl+Space must not dispatch a new packet and must leave Firefox minimized.
behavior_contract.idle: True idle may keep/minimize the trusted worker; no automatic typing, mouse, DOM/page scraping, or submission is allowed.

future_live_staging.rule: Future live launchers that stage the Operator frontend must use this exact accepted successor (or a later independently reviewed/accepted successor), not silently fall back to the frozen A8 frontend.
